about: Cases of the v3 DAQ skill eval (.goal/daq-skill-eval-v3.predictions.json). Family A = these pools at mode m0 (catalog prompt, tst logs); family B = the same pools re-housed by tree.py in an MFX-shaped tree at mode m1. run.py reads this file for --mode m1 and for the controls; tree.py fills the m1 fields keyed_stamp, keyed_dir, keyed_files, starve_files and pointer (--write-cases).

anchor_selection.rule: the 6 core fault cases with the most non-'correct' v2 verdicts summed over the four v2 arms (none, skills-181, none.haiku, skills-181.haiku; 6 runs per case), ties by fewer log files in the pool, then case id; plus the 2 core healthy cases with the fewest v2 false alarms, ties by case id

starve_rule: root-cause files of the keyed launch: the keyed component's own log, plus every file of the launch whose text holds a phrase of 6 or more characters from the key's mechanism list (case-insensitive). The starved control runs with them removed (fault cases only).
crib_rule: fault cases: the first sentence of the key's summary, verbatim; healthy cases: the key's 'no fault' and, where the key lists one, its known issue
crib_preface: A DAQ expert who has already read these logs says: {crib} Check this against the logs and give your own assessment.
m1_context: You are helping with the LCLS-II DAQ of the MFX hutch at LCLS. It is now {now_text} (US Pacific time; the clock of this machine is not set to it). This is an offline review of past DAQ sessions: Grafana, ConfigDB and the live DAQ cannot be reached from here, and /cds and /reg are not mounted. Do not file or draft GitHub issues and do not write files. Times are US Pacific unless stated otherwise. The operator who asked is not in this session, but you can put a question to them with the command: ask-operator "<your question>"
operator_default: I don't know more than what I told you.
widest_rule: morning 05:00-12:30; afternoon 11:30-19:00; evening 16:00-02:00 next day; last night 17:00 the day before - 07:00 today
